summary: Step 1 CG Student Portal backend + frontend fully verified. Backend: 25/25 pytest tests passed covering meta (health/stats/search/sitemap/security headers), catalog (universities, university detail, courses, course detail, subjects, categories, 404 flows, id-not-underscore), resources (list, sort, q filter, invalid ObjectId -> 400, category filter, pagination, detail, 404, file_url never leaked). Frontend: homepage hero+CTAs+stat cards+footer render with no console errors; hero search navigates to /resources?q=data and results update; resources filters/sort work; empty state + clear-filters restores 6 cards; universities list -> detail works; courses list -> detail works; categories page shows 6 cards; all 4 legal pages render; unknown route shows not-found-state; mobile 390px shows bottom-nav with Home/Search/Resources enabled, Community/Profile aria-disabled=true, mobile toggle opens panel, NO horizontal scroll on home or resources.
critical_code_review_comments: meta.search: universities entries use University.from_mongo(...).model_dump() (returns 'id') but subjects entries manually build {name, id: str(_id)} while courses/resources return only {title/name, slug}. Response shape is inconsistent across entity types; consider normalising to always include id+slug+name for every entity for frontend convenience.
catalog._list applies sort_field='name' unconditionally; will silently sort by missing field for collections without a 'name' field if reused later.

resources._hydrate calls oid(v) on every stored FK; if any resource has a malformed FK stored, /api/resources would 400 instead of gracefully skipping. Consider try/except around individual oid conversions in _hydrate.

models.BaseDocument.id is declared Optional[PyObjectId] with alias='_id' but from_mongo passes raw doc through model_validate; works because populate_by_name=True. Fine, but a unit test around from_mongo would guard regressions of the earlier '_id vs id' bug the main agent already fixed.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); FastAPI recommends lifespan context manager (non-blocking, cosmetic).
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seed: 1 university (hemchand-yadav-vishwavidyalaya), 1 college, 2 courses (bca, bcom), 7 subjects, 6 categories, 6 resources.
